quiz.question: When is it most appropriate to declare a function with a `void` return type?

answers.answer: When the function needs to return a `null` value.
When the function performs an action but does not need to return any data.
When the function has no parameters.
When the function needs to return an empty string (`""`).
The code will produce an error.
